mapper.select:
SELECT seqMainRecommend, targetType, seqTarget, activeYn, createdDate, title, content, thumbnail, detailUrl FROM ( SELECT mr.seqMainRecommend AS seqMainRecommend, mr.targetType AS targetType, mr.seqTarget AS seqTarget, mr.activeYn AS activeYn, TO_CHAR(mr.createdDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdDate, tp.title AS title, tp.content AS content, tp.thumbnailUrl AS thumbnail, '/travel/detail.do?seqTravelPost=' || tp.seqTravelPost AS detailUrl FROM main_recommend mr INNER JOIN travel_post tp ON mr.targetType = 'TRAVEL' AND mr.seqTarget = tp.seqTravelPost WHERE mr.activeYn = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT mr.seqMainRecommend AS seqMainRecommend, mr.targetType AS targetType, mr.seqTarget AS seqTarget, mr.activeYn AS activeYn, TO_CHAR(mr.createdDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdDate, bp.title AS title, bp.content AS content, bp.thumbnailUrl AS thumbnail, '/board/detail.do?seqBoardPost=' || bp.seqBoardPost AS detailUrl FROM main_recommend mr INNER JOIN board_post bp ON mr.targetType = 'BOARD' AND mr.seqTarget = bp.seqBoardPost WHERE mr.activeYn = 'Y' ) ORDER BY createdDate DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO main_recommend ( seqMainRecommend, targetType, seqTarget, activeYn, createdDate ) VALUES ( SEQMAINRECOMMEND.NEXTVAL, #{targetType}, #{seqTarget}, 'Y', SYSDATE )
